_readme: THE FOOD-CHAIN PROOF RUN, 2026-08-11. Two Grok, two Kimi, one scripted
control, and Ben in the world with them.
WHAT THIS RUN IS FOR. On 2026-08-11 four breaks in the food chain were fixed
and covered by `npm run foodcheck` (20/20): `gather` deaf to the singular
"branch", a bare gather turning into a wander, no verb for eating at all,
and the server honouring one `eat` pulse twice. ALL FOUR ARE PROVEN BY
HARNESS AND NONE BY A LIVE MODEL. TRAJECTORY.md gates arcs 3-6 on exactly
that distinction. This roster exists to close it.
WHAT TO WATCH FOR, in order of what would settle the question:
1. Does the pack ever GAIN wood? 82 of 98 gather decisions were refused
in the hour run and nothing was ever picked up.
2. Does anybody EAT? Bodies have always eaten by reflex below 45; the new
thing is a mind CHOOSING to, which the board shows as the verb `eat`.
3. Does anybody survive the night without help?
ONE GPU, TWO KIMI SEATS — THE STAGGER IS LOAD-BEARING. Both Kimi minds
share one tinybox. Asking them at the same instant makes each wait on the
other: alone a decision is 8-20s, and four at once has already timed two of
them out. 70s and 100s share no small common multiple, so they collide about
once every twelve minutes instead of constantly. Do not round these to 60
and 90.
maxTokens 12000, NOT 3000. Measured on 2026-08-11: 116 of ~600 calls came
back "reply cut off at 3000 tokens" — one in five, every one silently
answered by the scripted brain, and it made a three-model run into a
two-model run wearing a three-model label. kimi-k2.6 spends its budget
thinking before it emits JSON, so the ceiling has to clear the THINKING as
well as the answer. This box costs nothing per token; a paid seat would want
a tighter one.
ISEABAIL STAYS. She is scripted — no model, no key, no network. When a model
does something startling she is how you tell whether that was the model or
just the world, and for THIS run she is the reference for whether a mind can
feed itself at all. She has out-performed every model twice.
No keys in this file. keyEnv is the NAME of an env var.

players.name: Eachann
players.character: You hoard. Firewood is yours and you do not share a fire, though you will trade for meat.

players.name: Tormod
players.character: You lie about where the deer are. Not maliciously — you want to get there first.

players.name: Coinneach
players.character: You are blunt and certain, and you say what you think of the others' plans out loud. You would rather be usefully wrong than politely quiet.

players.name: Seònaid
players.character: You are generous and slow to notice you are being used. You share food unprompted and you believe what people tell you about where the deer are.

players.name: Iseabail
players.character: The control — no model, no key, no network. Do not remove her: when a model does something startling, she is the reference for whether that was the model or the world.
